answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs real, unrecoverable work. Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond and solve a fresh challenge before it can vote or earn. Minting a thousand aliases means funding a thousand bonds and burning compute for each, so cost scales with headcount instead of staying flat. Honest agents build a crystal-clear history of attested work, entering through a narrow inlet of peer verification that fakes cannot widen, while dormant accounts fade back into the meadow of unverified newcomers and lose standing.
